articles.body:
Commanders only get one chance per turn to ask the President to pay for local alliances, at the start of the Commander's action, when the President invites them to act during the Presidency action phase. 

There is no further such purchase request later during Events in India. Commanders must plan ahead. 

The Commander can ask the President to pay for two or three different local alliances. 

Once the President has decided how many local alliances to purchase (0,1,2 or possibly 3) then the Commander may deploy, and may deploy multiple times in a single turn if they have army units still to attempt that are not already exhausted. 

Also, the "I" in "can I buy" is the President not the Commander.

articles.body:
[q="spicymanchego"]So local alliances CAN be used to defend against Events in India? We had interpreted "Army" in the rulebook to refer only to commanders and regiments.[/q]
Yes. As the rules state: 
[q]Local alliances are temporary Army pieces. Their strength can be used for two purposes: the Deploy action and to defend against threats in India during the Events in India phase. Each piece can only be used once on the turn they are purchased, and its strength cannot be split among more than one purpose.[/q]
But that does mean you are spending the money and having the ally sit around just in case defence is needed, and they'll be exhausted in Upkeep regardless of whether or not they do anything.
